title: 'I died in horrific car crash – doctors couldn't believe who I met in afterlife'
excerpt: Jeanette Hedström was just 22 years old when she was involved in a horrific car crash and she has now reflected on what she experienced in the afterlife before returning to her broken body
content:
Jeanette Hedström was just 22 years old when she was involved in a horrific car crash and she has now reflected on what she experienced in the afterlife before returning to her broken body

08:06, 20 Sep 2026

Not all decisions are life or death but Jeanette Hedström will never forget the moment she had to choose between the two. It happened in July 2004 when the then 22-year-old was a passenger in a head-on crash in Jönköping, Sweden, in what was a terrifying moment that changed the course of her life.

‌

Jeanette’s sister was driving the car at speed when the collision caused her seatbelt to push all her internal organs under her heart. Remembering, she said: “So my diaphragm was ripped, my lungs were punctured. My spleen was up in my left shoulder, I also had a vertebrae in my spine and that got crushed.

‌

"Also my shoulder got crushed as well. So there was a lot of damage internal in my abdomen and all of my intestines were also underneath my heart. So I knew pretty quickly that I was dying, like I couldn’t breathe. I was so afraid. I was screaming out that I’m dying, I’m dying, I can’t breathe, I can’t breathe.

‌

“The pain in my body was so overwhelming. And the death anxiety I had was a fear I never felt before or probably never will. And what happened was that I released my body because the pain was so severe. It was like I had to get a break from it.”

She made the comments recently on The Other Side NDE on YouTube where she revealed who she met in the afterlife — something that was initially dismissed by doctors. However, she said the prediction about her future came true five years later.

‌

Jeanette recalled being released from her body before she ended up hovering above the car where she saw other vehicles stop and people run and she described it as being like a movie.

After briefly returning to her body, the pain was unbearable, and a voice told her to let go. And while it took emergency services 45 minutes to saw the roof off the car to get to them, Jeanette’s soul was taken elsewhere.

She said: “I just let go and in an instant I was in the light. I ended up in something that I call the waiting room. And in here everything was just bright, it was like a blinding light, but it wasn’t blinding, it was just very warm, very loving, very unconditional. It was like waking up. I did not recall that I had a body, that I had just been in an accident, it just felt like I was home. I belonged there.”

‌

According to Jeanette, she met three big energies, the first one being her godmother who had died 10 years previously. She told her that she had to return to her body, but Jeanette initially didn’t want to, because it felt like she was already home.

However, speaking about who she met, she continued: “I got a life review from my mother’s womb. I saw my life and I also saw my future. They showed me all of it and what would happen if I decided not to go back to my body. They showed me because they said also that I have contracts that I have already signed and I got to see my children and I got to see and feel my husband’s energy.

‌

“They also told me that this energy that I own in this body is very unique and it’s supposed to be here and it’s very important that I go back to my body because I saw my husband and we started like this new lights, this new vibrations that is our children and they showed me what would happen if I chose not to go back.”

She also claimed she began to hear the prayers of people on earth who cared for her and were wishing that she pulled through. And after realising she had an agreement with her future husband and children, she decided to choose life, before being transported back to her body.

‌

Jeanette explained that this was the “darkest” and “most scary” part of her NDE and she woke up in her broken body and was struggling to communicate.

She had been in a coma for three days and had undergone lifesaving surgery, which involved the temporary removal of her organs, to save her life. Initially, medics feared she would die, before she began breathing on a ventilator.

She also had her eyelids stitched back together, a titanium rod put in her arm and three vertebrae in her back fused. And despite still being classified as disabled due to the injuries, she made a full recovery, and no longer lives with any pain.

‌

However, at the time of the accident, Jeanette had never heard of a near-death experience, and she was dismissed by doctors who refused to believe what she saw on the other side.

She said: “When I tried to speak about it they just said you dreamt that. You were on heavy medication. This trauma is your brain making it up and stuff like that.”

This made feel quite alone and she no longer wanted to share it and she added: “So when they told me it wasn’t true, I just hid it away.”

However, the memory of what happened is still crystal clear 22 years later, and she now sees what happened to her as a gift, despite acknowledging that the pain during the accident was the “most horrific thing that has ever happened to me”.

But as for the premonition coming true, she said: “Today, 21 years later, I now see how much it shaped me to be the person that I am today. And five years after my accident, I found my husband.

“And we have two beautiful children today that I know that I have this contract with. And I tell them so often that they were the reason why I chose to come back. So the best part of my NDE is like I got this knowing that we are all unique and there’s no accident of us being here.”
